head: HopFinder is a Space-A travel app for military flight schedules
dek: HopFinder collects Space-A flight schedules from military AMC passenger terminals around the world in one iPhone and iPad app for retirees, veterans, service members and their families. It came out on 24 November for $3.99 and was #37 in paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 26 November.
details: You can see 72-hour departure schedules, Patriot Express flights and roll call results, search by base, destination or region, and open a terminal's original posted schedule. Alerts for a base, route or destination arrive when new schedules are posted. The developer, Collin Hurlburt, says it needs no account and has no ads or tracking. It isn't affiliated with the DoD, the Air Force or AMC, and the listing says Space-A seats are never guaranteed.
where: iPhone and iPad, $3.99, out since 24 November
means: If you can fly Space-A, you can check several terminals' schedules in one place instead of looking up each one.
todo: Confirm a flight with the terminal before you travel, as the listing advises, since schedules can change without notice.
